Inside Macintosh: Advanced Color Imaging Reference /
Chapter 3 - ColorSync Manager Reference for Applications and Device Drivers / Constants and Data Types

Using Picture Comments

Your application uses the QuickDraw PicComment function, described in Inside Macintosh: Imaging With QuickDraw, to specify picture comments for beginning or ending use of an embedded profile, turning color matching on or off, or embedding a profile identifier.
